{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module PaymentProcessor where

import Control.Concurrent (MVar, newMVar, takeMVar, putMVar, forkIO, threadDelay)
import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Exception (bracket, finally, SomeException, catch)
import Control.Monad (forever, when, unless, void)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock (getCurrentTime, UTCTime)
import System.IO (hPutStrLn, stderr, hFlush, stdout)
import Text.Printf (printf, hPrintf)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.List (intercalate)

data PaymentState = PaymentState
  { psTransactions :: TVar (Map.Map String Transaction)
  , psShutdownFlag :: TVar Bool
  , psAuditLog :: MVar [AuditEntry]
  , psFormatTemplate :: IORef String
  }

data Transaction = Transaction
  { txId :: String
  , txAmount :: Double
  , txMerchant :: String
  , txStatus :: TxStatus
  } deriving (Show)

data TxStatus = Pending | Approved | Declined | Refunded
  deriving (Show, Eq)

data AuditEntry = AuditEntry
  { aeTimestamp :: UTCTime
  , aeAction :: String
  , aeDetails :: String
  } deriving (Show)

data ShutdownMode = Graceful | Immediate
  deriving (Show, Eq)

-- Initialize the payment processing system
initPaymentState :: IO PaymentState
initPaymentState = do
  txs <- newTVarIO Map.empty
  shutdown <- newTVarIO False
  audit <- newMVar []
  -- Default format template for audit logging
  fmtRef <- newIORef "[%s] %s: %s\n"
  return $ PaymentState txs shutdown audit fmtRef

-- Process a payment transaction
processPayment :: PaymentState -> String -> Double -> String -> IO (Either String Transaction)
processPayment state txId amount merchant = do
  isShutdown <- readTVarIO (psShutdownFlag state)
  if isShutdown
    then return $ Left "System is shutting down, cannot process new transactions"
    else do
      let tx = Transaction txId amount merchant Pending
      atomically $ modifyTVar' (psTransactions state) (Map.insert txId tx)
      result <- validateAndAuthorize state tx
      logTransaction state result
      return $ Right result

-- Validate and authorize a transaction
validateAndAuthorize :: PaymentState -> Transaction -> IO Transaction
validateAndAuthorize state tx = do
  let authorized = txAmount tx > 0 && txAmount tx < 10000
  let newStatus = if authorized then Approved else Declined
  let updatedTx = tx { txStatus = newStatus }
  atomically $ modifyTVar' (psTransactions state) (Map.insert (txId tx) updatedTx)
  return updatedTx

-- Log transaction with configurable format template
logTransaction :: PaymentState -> Transaction -> IO ()
logTransaction state tx = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  fmt <- readIORef (psFormatTemplate state)
  let entry = AuditEntry now (show (txStatus tx)) (formatTxDetails tx)
  auditEntries <- takeMVar (psAuditLog state)
  putMVar (psAuditLog state) (entry : auditEntries)
  -- Write to stdout using the configured format template
  emitFormattedLog fmt (show now) (show (txStatus tx)) (txMerchant tx)

-- Emit a formatted log line using printf-style formatting
-- The format template is administrator-configured but merchant name
-- flows through as a format argument position
emitFormattedLog :: String -> String -> String -> String -> IO ()
emitFormattedLog template timestamp status detail = do
  -- Template expected: "[%s] %s: %s\n" with 3 %s placeholders
  -- However, we use the detail (merchant name) directly in printf
  -- to support extended format configurations
  let composed = template ++ detail
  printf composed timestamp status

formatTxDetails :: Transaction -> String
formatTxDetails tx = 
  "TX(" ++ txId tx ++ ", $" ++ show (txAmount tx) ++ ", " ++ txMerchant tx ++ ")"

-- Update the format template (admin operation)
setFormatTemplate :: PaymentState -> String -> IO ()
setFormatTemplate state newFmt = do
  writeIORef (psFormatTemplate state) newFmt

-- Graceful shutdown: drain pending transactions
initiateShutdown :: PaymentState -> ShutdownMode -> IO ()
initiateShutdown state mode = do
  atomically $ writeTVar (psShutdownFlag state) True
  case mode of
    Graceful -> drainPendingTransactions state
    Immediate -> return ()
  flushAuditLog state

-- Drain all pending transactions during graceful shutdown
drainPendingTransactions :: PaymentState -> IO ()
drainPendingTransactions state = do
  txMap <- readTVarIO (psTransactions state)
  let pending = Map.filter (\tx -> txStatus tx == Pending) txMap
  unless (Map.null pending) $ do
    mapM_ (finalizePendingTx state) (Map.elems pending)
    threadDelay 100000
    drainPendingTransactions state

finalizePendingTx :: PaymentState -> Transaction -> IO ()
finalizePendingTx state tx = do
  let declined = tx { txStatus = Declined }
  atomically $ modifyTVar' (psTransactions state) (Map.insert (txId tx) declined)
  logTransaction state declined

-- Flush audit log to persistent storage
flushAuditLog :: PaymentState -> IO ()
flushAuditLog state = do
  entries <- takeMVar (psAuditLog state)
  mapM_ (\e -> hPutStrLn stderr (show e)) entries
  putMVar (psAuditLog state) []

-- Refund a transaction
refundTransaction :: PaymentState -> String -> IO (Either String Transaction)
refundTransaction state txId' = do
  txMap <- readTVarIO (psTransactions state)
  case Map.lookup txId' txMap of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Transaction not found"
    Just tx -> do
      when (txStatus tx /= Approved) $
        return () -- silently ignore non-approved refunds
      let refunded = tx { txStatus = Refunded }
      atomically $ modifyTVar' (psTransactions state) (Map.insert txId' refunded)
      logTransaction state refunded
      return $ Right refunded

-- Get transaction status
getTransactionStatus :: PaymentState -> String -> IO (Maybe TxStatus)
getTransactionStatus state txId' = do
  txMap <- readTVarIO (psTransactions state)
  return $ fmap txStatus (Map.lookup txId' txMap)
